pages.text: [#](53341a)There are those who choose this path and those who have it chosen for them. Either way, the nature of vampirism is not subtle: you are sustained by blood, strengthened by it, and diminished without it.[#]()
pages.title: Vampirism

pages.text: [#](53341a)Blood Power is the red-drop reserve beside the hotbar. Stand on hotbar slot 1, then press its key again or use the mouse wheel to cycle the powers your level has unlocked.[#]()
[#](53341a)Use the selected power to invoke it; Drink and Mesmerise act on the living creature beneath your gaze.[#]()
[#](53341a)A well-fed vampire is swift, strong, and keen-eyed. Drink is free from the first level and draws blood from Villagers, Village Guards, living creatures, and mortal players.[#]()
pages.title: What the Blood Gives

pages.text: [#](53341a)Mortals hold 500 human blood, recover two every forty ticks, and yield less while awake than while sleeping. Villagers yield a full bite while sleeping or mesmerised. Werewolf blood burns the drinker instead.[#]()

[#](53341a)The blood-drop display beneath the crosshair shows what remains in a Villager, Village Guard, or mortal player whenever a vampire holds them in view.[#]() [#](53341a)The curse also works without spending Blood Power.[#]()
[#](53341a)In human form, level 1 doubles ordinary attack damage, level 4 triples it, and level 7 quadruples it.[#]()

[#](53341a)From level 3, a sneaking strike launches its victim; from level 6, sneak-punching Stone, Netherrack, or Cobblestone with an unsuitable tool crushes it at a heavy hunger cost.[#]() [#](53341a)Water cannot steal a vampire's breath and poison cannot hold.[#]()
[#](53341a)Fire Resistance still cannot hide active flame from the curse.[#]()

[#](53341a)Level 1: **Drink**, free. Level 2: **Mesmerise**, 50 Blood Power; use it on a Villager, Village Guard, or player, or sneak-use it to toggle vampire vision. Level 4: **Speed**, 10 power; repeated uses double the current burst where mastery permits.[#]()
pages.title: The Five Powers

pages.text: [#](53341a)Level 7: **Bat Form**, 50 power to enter and one power every forty ticks to remain. You become one compact flying bat and return freely. Level 10: **Ultimate**, which spends a Blood Crucible charge only when its working succeeds.[#]()
[#](53341a)All activations share the old ten-tick pause.[#]()
[#](53341a)**Call Storm** refuses an already-raining sky, then brings five to fifteen minutes of rain and thunder. **Summon Swarm** calls fifteen owned Attack Bats.[#]()
pages.title: The Three Ultimates

pages.text: [#](53341a)**Return Home** carries you to your bed or world spawn, or to a nearby village when you are already close to home; it refuses the Spirit World.[#]() [#](53341a)Choose the ultimate at a full Blood Crucible.[#]()
[#](53341a)Each successful invocation spends one of its charges; a refused invocation leaves the charge untouched.[#]()

[#](53341a)Sunlight burns; direct daylight is a constant danger. Silver wounds heal slowly and hurt more. Witch Hunters treat you as a professional priority. Blood drains constantly — feed regularly. And there is no going back, not easily.[#]()
pages.title: What the Blood Costs

pages.text: [#](53341a)Woven Cruor is the base cloth. At level 4+, spend 125 Blood Power with a **Bone Needle** on placed White Wool to make Blood-stained Wool, then smelt it to Woven Cruor and tailor the light set.[#]()
pages.title: Vampire Clothing

pages.text: [#](53341a)Two light pieces make your bite draw more blood; three extend mesmerise and grant a chance to survive lethal fire, which all four make much stronger.[#]()
[#](53341a)A Stake is simple and final: craft one from a Stick ringed with Garlic, then use it on a sleeping vampire to destroy them.[#]()
pages.title: The Stake

pages.text: [#](53341a)The Glass Goblet is the other path — a level-9 vampire can fill it with 125 Blood Power, and drinking a filled goblet begins vampirism unless the drinker is a werewolf.[#]()

[#](53341a)Lilith may also fill an empty goblet after she is bested; drink that blood to accept the curse. Garlic asks her to lift vampirism, a poppy asks for deeper mastery, and an enchantable item asks for her old blessing.[#]()
